recette.accroche: How well do you know your partner?
recette.consigne: 8 questions, 5 seconds each. Count your right answers!
questions: What would they buy with a surprise 100?
What is the best gift you gave them?
Do they love surprises or hate them?
What gift did they secretly dislike?
What would they never want to receive?

fin.question: How many did you get? Comment your score!

en.legende:
Gifts edition: 8 questions about what your partner loves to receive. Do you pick the right gift?

Comment your score!
